sections.title: Mental model
sections.body:
Two intersecting concerns:

- **Performance** — Core Web Vitals: LCP, INP, CLS.
- **SEO** — semantic HTML + meta tags + structured data + sitemap.

Senior signal: tie perf to *user-visible metrics*, not synthetic scores.

sections.title: Must-know concepts
sections.body:
The interview surface for this module breaks into these focus areas:

- **Core web vitals** — drill the named patterns, the failure modes, and the recommended Java / framework idiom.
- **Critical rendering path** — drill the named patterns, the failure modes, and the recommended Java / framework idiom.
- **Lazy loading and code splitting** — drill the named patterns, the failure modes, and the recommended Java / framework idiom.
- **Image and asset optimization** — drill the named patterns, the failure modes, and the recommended Java / framework idiom.
- **Caching and http2 http3** — drill the named patterns, the failure modes, and the recommended Java / framework idiom.
- **Seo fundamentals frontend** — drill the named patterns, the failure modes, and the recommended Java / framework idiom.
- **Meta tags and structured data** — drill the named patterns, the failure modes, and the recommended Java / framework idiom.
- **Performance budgets and profiling** — drill the named patterns, the failure modes, and the recommended Java / framework idiom.
- **Scenario-based** — applied questions tying multiple topics together. Drill these *last*, after the fundamentals are sharp.

sections.title: Likely interview hooks
sections.body:
- **LCP < 2.5s** — image / font / hero element optimisation.
- **INP** replaced FID in 2024 — measures interaction *responsiveness*.
- **CLS < 0.1** — reserve space for images / ads / late-loaded UI.
- **SSR / SSG** for SEO-critical pages; CSR fine for app shells.
- **Structured data** — JSON-LD; powers rich snippets.

sections.title: Speaking template
sections.body: > *"I'd measure with field data (Web Vitals lib) not just lab, optimise LCP via preloading the hero, fix CLS by reserving space, keep INP low by avoiding long tasks, ship SSR for SEO-critical routes, and add JSON-LD where rich snippets help."*
